rendered: The NiTi wires were strained axially in tension, to 5%[1] and 10%[2] strain. The coating was subjected to axial tensile strains of 0−10%[3], and the applied strains were 5% and 10%[4]. Owing to the shape-memory property of NiTi, these strains were maintained after unloading, which locks strain into the V2O5 film. The Methods describe the strained wires as subjected to axial tensile deformation up to 5%[5] and 10% strains[6] at a rate of 2[7] mm/min.
